name: cnt
description: Number of distinct entities counted in this aggregate cell.
details: The counted entity depends on the table (patient, encounter, note or report). Inspect its count expression and suppression threshold; do not sum overlapping cube cells.

name: encounter_ref_link
description: Retained study encounter assigned to the evidence record.

name: encounter_ref_link_col
description: Linking method: source encounter reference or date-based linkage.

name: age_at_visit
description: Age in years at the encounter, from core encounter data.

name: age_group
description: Age-group code assigned by the age-at-visit lookup.
details: Bands (integer years at the visit): 0=age_00_to_01 (Infant); 1-4=age_01_to_05 (Early childhood); 5-11=age_05_to_12 (Childhood); 12-17=age_12_to_18 (Adolescent); 18-25=age_18_to_26 (Young adult); 26-64=age_26_to_65 (Adult); 65-120=age_65_to_121 (Older adult). Every age in include_age_at_visit.csv (0-120) has a row in age_group.csv.

name: status
description: Encounter status in the study population table.

name: enc_period_ordinal
description: Encounter period ordinal used for utilization counting.

name: enc_period_end_day_filled
description: Encounter end date, falling back to start date when missing.

name: code
description: Coding value matched by the valueset.

name: variable
description: Valueset variable identifier in the union tables.

name: tier
details: Retained as a string from CSV. Broad diagnosis codes do not independently confirm a histologic subtype.

name: subtype
description: Tumor subtype label in the case-definition valueset.
details: In pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes it is the PCX-30 medulloblastoma molecular subtype instead: WNT, SHH, Group 3, Group 4, non-WNT/non-SHH, or NOS/NEC when no group is documented.

name: birthdate
details: Used for month-level age at time zero and at definitive surgery. Confirm the site ETL has not truncated birthDate to year.

name: t0_day
description: Time zero: LLM gold diagnosis day, else the first encounter with a tier 1 medulloblastoma casedef code.
details: The earliest day-precision diagnosis_gold_day from any diagnosis-task note naming an embryonal subtype (ATRT included), else the first study-population encounter carrying a tier 1 medulloblastoma casedef code (pcx__eligible_dx). Tier 2 codes and the CHOP roster are evidence only. NULL when neither exists. Tables: pcx__eligible_*, pcx__outcome_*.

name: t0_source
details: llm_diagnosis_gold or casedef_tier1_medulloblastoma. NULL when t0_day is NULL.

name: casedef_t0_day
description: First encounter with a tier 1 medulloblastoma casedef code.
details: The coded time zero, kept beside t0_day for QA even when the LLM gold day wins. Compared with the LLM diagnosis dates in the dx_date_disagree warn checks.

name: llm_t0_gold_day
description: Earliest day-precision diagnosis_gold_day across diagnosis-task notes naming any embryonal subtype.
details: Sets t0_day when present. Month or year precision dates are excluded, unlike llm_diagnosis_gold_day_min.

name: age_months_at_t0
description: Completed months from birthdate to t0_day.
details: DATE_DIFF month. NULL when t0_day is NULL. The ACNS0334 criterion is age at definitive surgery, not at diagnosis; see age_months_at_definitive_surgery.

name: age_under_36_months_at_t0
details: Diagnosis-anchored age flag, carried to pcx__eligible beside age_under_36_months_at_definitive_surgery. A flag only: subjects 36 months or older at t0 stay in pcx__eligible. Not the trial criterion. NULL when t0_day or birthdate is NULL.

name: age_band_at_t0
details: Stratifier for the all-ages discovery cohort (README section 1). NULL when t0_day is NULL.

name: age_under_8_months_at_t0
details: One of the four ACNS0334 high-risk qualifiers (diagnosis under 8 months). Adjudicate the stratum downstream with metastasis, histology and residual disease.

name: medulloblastoma_tier1_bool
description: TRUE when any tier 1 medulloblastoma casedef code exists for the subject.
details: Structured diagnosis evidence. Compare with llm_medulloblastoma_bool.

name: atrt_tier1_bool
description: TRUE when any tier 1 ATRT casedef code (9508/3, SNOMED 715659006) exists for the subject.
details: Tier 3 ATRT rows (unspecified brain neoplasm) are ignored here on purpose.

name: atrt_first_day
description: First encounter with a tier 1 ATRT casedef code.

name: atrt_confirmed_bool
description: TRUE when structured tier 1 or LLM diagnosis evidence names ATRT.
details: ACNS0334 exclusion. FALSE when neither source names ATRT, which is absence of evidence, not a pathology result. Table: pcx__eligible.

name: llm_medulloblastoma_bool
description: TRUE when any diagnosis-task note gives disease_subtype MEDULLOBLASTOMA.
details: Source: pcx__llm_diagnosis_wide. NULL when the subject has no diagnosis-task output.

name: llm_atrt_bool
description: TRUE when any diagnosis-task note gives disease_subtype ATRT.
details: Source: pcx__llm_diagnosis_wide. NULL when the subject has no diagnosis-task output.

name: llm_diagnosis_day_min
details: Hard cast to DATE. Precision is not carried here; month or year placeholders are first-of-period dates.

name: llm_diagnosis_gold_day_min
description: Earliest confirmatory tissue-diagnosis date across diagnosis-task notes.
details: Usually the resection or biopsy date. Candidate proxy for definitive surgery when no surgery evidence exists.

name: llm_age_months_at_diagnosis_gold
display: LLM age months at diagnosis gold
description: Completed months from birthdate to llm_diagnosis_gold_day_min.
details: Provisional age gate before running the surgery task.

name: llm_age_at_diagnosis_months_min
display: LLM age at diagnosis months min
description: Smallest explicitly stated age at diagnosis in months across notes.
details: Extracted text, not computed from dates.

name: llm_metastatic_bool
description: TRUE when any diagnosis-task note states Chang M1 to M4.
details: Directly stated M-stage only. Derived staging from metastasis-task inputs is a downstream step.

name: llm_anaplastic_bool
description: TRUE when any diagnosis-task note gives large-cell/anaplastic histology.
details: ACNS0334 high-risk qualifier.

name: definitive_surgery_day
description: Date of the definitive tumor resection.
details: Precedence: earliest LLM resection (extent_of_resection gross total, near total or partial), then first structured tier 1 craniotomy. See definitive_surgery_source. Table: pcx__eligible_surgery.

name: definitive_surgery_source
details: llm_surgery_resection or proc_craniotomy_tier1_first. NULL when neither source has a date.

name: proc_craniotomy_tier1_first_day
details: Structured fallback for definitive surgery.

name: proc_craniotomy_tier1_cnt
description: Number of distinct tier 1 craniotomy procedures.
details: More than one suggests second-look or recurrence surgery is present.

name: llm_surgery_first_day
description: Earliest surgery_date across surgery-task notes, any role.

name: llm_definitive_surgery_day
description: Earliest surgery_date whose extent_of_resection is a resection.
details: Resection means GROSS_TOTAL_RESECTION, NEAR_TOTAL_RESECTION or PARTIAL_RESECTION. Biopsy and NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE rows never pick the day.

name: llm_age_at_definitive_surgery_months
display: LLM age at definitive surgery months
description: Explicitly stated age in months at the definitive operation.
details: Extracted text, compare with age_months_at_definitive_surgery.

name: llm_residual_tumor_area_cm2_min
description: Smallest explicit postoperative residual area in cm2.
details: Never inferred from GTR/NTR/STR labels.

name: llm_residual_tumor_area_cm2_max
description: Largest explicit postoperative residual area in cm2.
details: ACNS0334 high-risk threshold is 1.5 cm2; apply it downstream, not here.

name: llm_residual_disease_bool
description: TRUE when any surgery-task note gives extent PARTIAL_RESECTION or BIOPSY.
details: Label-based residual disease, distinct from a measured area.

name: age_months_at_definitive_surgery
description: Completed months from birthdate to definitive_surgery_day.
details: The ACNS0334 age criterion is evaluated on this column.

name: age_under_36_months_at_definitive_surgery
display: Age under 36 months at definitive surgery
details: ACNS0334 inclusion criterion, applied only by pcx__eligible_trial. A flag in pcx__eligible. NULL when no definitive surgery date exists.

name: methotrexate_first_day
description: Earliest methotrexate administration or ACNS0334 Regimen B date.
details: Methotrexate exposure is any LLM-documented ADMINISTERED methotrexate, agent or dose level, any route (llm_administered; the CHOP clinical team treats any methotrexate as high-dose), or an ACNS0334 regimen with documented_trial_arm REGIMEN_B, by its regimen start or the methotrexate administered in it (llm_acns0334_regimen_b). Structured orders and dispenses are evidence only. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_source
description: Which LLM sources gave methotrexate exposure evidence, comma-separated.
details: llm_acns0334_regimen_b and/or llm_administered, dated or not. NULL when there is no methotrexate exposure evidence. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_administered_first_day
description: Earliest LLM-documented ADMINISTERED methotrexate, agent or dose level, any route.
details: Methotrexate exposure is any LLM-documented ADMINISTERED methotrexate, agent or dose level, any route (llm_administered; the CHOP clinical team treats any methotrexate as high-dose), or an ACNS0334 regimen with documented_trial_arm REGIMEN_B, by its regimen start or the methotrexate administered in it (llm_acns0334_regimen_b). Structured orders and dispenses are evidence only. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_intrathecal_or_ventricular_first_day
display: Methotrexate intrathecal or ventricular first day
description: Earliest ADMINISTERED methotrexate dose given intrathecally or intraventricularly.
details: Evidence only, counted as exposure today. Open question to the CHOP clinician whether it should count. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_high_dose_first_day
description: Earliest ADMINISTERED methotrexate the note explicitly calls high-dose.
details: Evidence only: any administered methotrexate is exposure, with or without the label. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_regimen_b_first_day
description: Earliest ACNS0334 Regimen B regimen start or methotrexate administered within it.
details: Methotrexate exposure is any LLM-documented ADMINISTERED methotrexate, agent or dose level, any route (llm_administered; the CHOP clinical team treats any methotrexate as high-dose), or an ACNS0334 regimen with documented_trial_arm REGIMEN_B, by its regimen start or the methotrexate administered in it (llm_acns0334_regimen_b). Structured orders and dispenses are evidence only. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_order_first_day
details: Structured evidence only: never sets methotrexate_first_day or methotrexate_any_bool (no dose or route). Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_dispense_first_day
details: Structured evidence only: never sets methotrexate_first_day or methotrexate_any_bool (no dose or route). Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_any_bool
description: TRUE when any methotrexate administration or ACNS0334 Regimen B evidence exists, dated or not, FALSE when none.
details: Structured orders and dispenses do not count. Timing in initial therapy is in pcx__outcome_exposure. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_administered_bool
description: TRUE when any LLM-documented methotrexate is ADMINISTERED, dated or not.
details: Methotrexate exposure is any LLM-documented ADMINISTERED methotrexate, agent or dose level, any route (llm_administered; the CHOP clinical team treats any methotrexate as high-dose), or an ACNS0334 regimen with documented_trial_arm REGIMEN_B, by its regimen start or the methotrexate administered in it (llm_acns0334_regimen_b). Structured orders and dispenses are evidence only. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_undated_bool
description: TRUE when a methotrexate exposure has no usable date, so its timing is unknown.
details: Methotrexate exposure is any LLM-documented ADMINISTERED methotrexate, agent or dose level, any route (llm_administered; the CHOP clinical team treats any methotrexate as high-dose), or an ACNS0334 regimen with documented_trial_arm REGIMEN_B, by its regimen start or the methotrexate administered in it (llm_acns0334_regimen_b). Structured orders and dispenses are evidence only. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_intrathecal_or_ventricular_bool
description: TRUE when any ADMINISTERED methotrexate dose is intrathecal or intraventricular.
details: Evidence only, counted as exposure today. Open question to the CHOP clinician whether it should count. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_not_received_bool
description: TRUE when a note documents methotrexate as EXPLICITLY_NOT_RECEIVED, agent or dose level.
details: Makes had_initial_methotrexate_bool FALSE when no methotrexate is in the initial window. Silence is FALSE here and never means not received. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_high_dose_bool
description: TRUE when any ADMINISTERED methotrexate is explicitly called high-dose, dated or not.
details: Evidence only: any administered methotrexate is exposure, with or without the label. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: methotrexate_regimen_b_bool
description: TRUE when any ACNS0334 regimen documents trial arm REGIMEN_B.
details: Methotrexate exposure is any LLM-documented ADMINISTERED methotrexate, agent or dose level, any route (llm_administered; the CHOP clinical team treats any methotrexate as high-dose), or an ACNS0334 regimen with documented_trial_arm REGIMEN_B, by its regimen start or the methotrexate administered in it (llm_acns0334_regimen_b). Structured orders and dispenses are evidence only. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_first_day
description: Earliest backbone chemotherapy date from any source.
details: Backbone agents are the six rx_chemo_* valuesets. The LLM branch counts every administered agent, methotrexate included (workplan 3.4). Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order), MedicationDispense hand-overs (rx_dispense) and LLM systemic-therapy agents or doses with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered), earliest wins. An order or a dispense is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_order_first_day
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order), MedicationDispense hand-overs (rx_dispense) and LLM systemic-therapy agents or doses with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered), earliest wins. An order or a dispense is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_dispense_first_day
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order), MedicationDispense hand-overs (rx_dispense) and LLM systemic-therapy agents or doses with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered), earliest wins. An order or a dispense is not receipt. Cancelled and declined dispenses are dropped. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_administered_first_day
description: Earliest LLM-documented administered agent start date.
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order), MedicationDispense hand-overs (rx_dispense) and LLM systemic-therapy agents or doses with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered), earliest wins. An order or a dispense is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_any_bool
description: TRUE when any backbone chemotherapy order, dispense or administration exists, FALSE when none.
details: Candidate union of MedicationRequest orders (rx_order), MedicationDispense hand-overs (rx_dispense) and LLM systemic-therapy agents or doses with delivery_status ADMINISTERED (llm_administered), earliest wins. An order or a dispense is not receipt. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_administered_bool
description: TRUE when any LLM-documented chemotherapy agent is ADMINISTERED, dated or not.
details: Agent or dose level, every agent except the supportive markers LEUCOVORIN, MESNA and DEXRAZOXANE. Orders and dispenses do not count. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_undated_bool
description: TRUE when a chemotherapy exposure has no usable date, so its timing is unknown.
details: LLM agents or doses ADMINISTERED without a date. Table: pcx__eligible_rx.

name: chemo_prior_to_t0_bool
description: TRUE when a dated chemotherapy record ends before t0_day.
details: Yes/no flag, never an exclusion in pcx__eligible. By the range of days each dated record can fall on (a month or year date covers the whole period): TRUE when a record ends before t0_day, NULL when t0_day is NULL or a record straddles it and none ends before it, FALSE otherwise. No evidence, or undated evidence only, is FALSE. pcx__eligible_trial excludes TRUE and NULL. ACNS0334 no prior chemotherapy. Steroids are not chemotherapy. Tables: pcx__eligible_rx, pcx__eligible.

name: methotrexate_prior_to_t0_bool
description: TRUE when a dated methotrexate record ends before t0_day.
details: Yes/no flag, never an exclusion in pcx__eligible. By the range of days each dated record can fall on (a month or year date covers the whole period): TRUE when a record ends before t0_day, NULL when t0_day is NULL or a record straddles it and none ends before it, FALSE otherwise. No evidence, or undated evidence only, is FALSE. pcx__eligible_trial excludes TRUE and NULL. ACNS0334 excludes any prior chemotherapy, methotrexate included. Tables: pcx__eligible_rx, pcx__eligible.

name: radiation_first_day
description: Earliest radiation date from any source.
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: radiation_proc_first_day
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: radiation_dx_first_day
description: Earliest tier 1 radiotherapy encounter code recorded date.
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: radiation_administered_first_day
description: Earliest LLM-documented delivered radiation start date.
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: radiation_any_bool
description: TRUE when any radiation evidence exists, FALSE when none.
details: Any dose, any field, any time (README section 2). Timing relative to the first event is in pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: radiation_administered_bool
description: TRUE when an LLM radiation round is ADMINISTERED.
details: Candidate union of tier 1 proc_radiation procedures, tier 1 dx_radiation encounter codes, and LLM radiation rounds with delivery_status ADMINISTERED. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: radiation_undated_bool
description: TRUE when radiation evidence has no usable date, so its timing is unknown.
details: Same sources as radiation_first_day. Table: pcx__eligible_radiation.

name: llm_craniospinal_bool
description: TRUE when any LLM radiation round has a craniospinal field.
details: CRANIOSPINAL or CRANIOSPINAL_WITH_FOCAL_BOOST.

name: llm_proton_bool
description: TRUE when any LLM radiation round uses protons.

name: llm_explicitly_not_received_bool
description: TRUE when a note explicitly documents that radiation was not received.
details: Explicit negative through the assessed date. Silence is NULL.

name: radiation_prior_to_t0_bool
description: TRUE when a dated radiation record ends before t0_day.
details: Yes/no flag, never an exclusion in pcx__eligible. By the range of days each dated record can fall on (a month or year date covers the whole period): TRUE when a record ends before t0_day, NULL when t0_day is NULL or a record straddles it and none ends before it, FALSE otherwise. No evidence, or undated evidence only, is FALSE. pcx__eligible_trial excludes TRUE and NULL. ACNS0334 no prior radiation. Tables: pcx__eligible_radiation, pcx__eligible.

name: exposure
details: methotrexate is any LLM-administered methotrexate or ACNS0334 Regimen B, methotrexate_structured is orders and dispenses (evidence only). Table: pcx__exposure_record.

name: source
description: Evidence source of an exposure record.
details: rx_order, rx_dispense, proc_radiation, dx_radiation, llm_administered or llm_acns0334_regimen_b. Table: pcx__exposure_record.

name: exposure_day
description: Day as recorded, the first day of its month or year for a coarse date, NULL when undated.
details: Table: pcx__exposure_record.

name: day_precision
description: DAY, MONTH or YEAR for a dated record, NULL when undated.
details: Structured FHIR dates are DAY. Table: pcx__exposure_record.

name: earliest_day
description: Earliest day the record can fall on.
details: exposure_day for a dated record, NULL (no lower bound) when undated. Table: pcx__exposure_record.

name: latest_day
description: Latest day the record can fall on.
details: The day itself, the last day of a month or year, or for an undated LLM mention the date of its note (pcx__llm_note_date, FHIR metadata), NULL when the note has no date. Table: pcx__exposure_record.

name: restated_bool
description: TRUE for an undated mention when a dated record of the same exposure starts on or before its note date.
details: A restatement of treatment already on record, ignored for timing. Table: pcx__exposure_record.

name: high_dose_bool
description: high_dose_methotrexate_explicit_bool of an administered methotrexate dose.
details: Evidence only. Table: pcx__exposure_record.

name: route
description: AdministrationRoute of an administered dose, NULL at the agent level.
details: Table: pcx__exposure_record.

name: deceased_bool
description: TRUE when any source records death.
details: Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status. Sources: raw FHIR patient deceasedBoolean/deceasedDateTime, LLM survival_timeline task vital_status and death_date, LLM event task DECEASED (dated or not). pcx__outcome_first_event takes death from here, so OS and EFS share it. A deceased flag without a date leaves death_day NULL.

name: death_day
description: Earliest recorded death date across sources, an exact day preferred.
details: Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status. Sources: raw FHIR patient deceasedBoolean/deceasedDateTime, LLM survival_timeline task vital_status and death_date, LLM event task DECEASED (dated or not). pcx__outcome_first_event takes death from here, so OS and EFS share it. Actual death date, never a substitute. The earliest exact day wins when no source's month or year period ends before it (FHIR 2020-12-10 beats an LLM "2020"). Otherwise the earliest day, a month or year LLM date at the middle of its period (the 15th, July 1), with death_day_imputed_bool TRUE.

name: last_known_alive_day
description: Latest date the patient is documented alive.
details: Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status. Sources: raw FHIR patient deceasedBoolean/deceasedDateTime, latest study-population encounter end, LLM patient task. Latest of last encounter end and LLM last-known-alive. OS censoring date for patients without a death. A month or year LLM date is used at the middle of its period, with last_known_alive_day_imputed_bool TRUE.

name: death_earliest_day
description: Earliest day the death can fall on, the start of a month or year date.
details: Earliest start over every dated death source, or death_day when an exact day wins. pcx__outcome_first_event compares treatment against death_earliest_day to death_latest_day. Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status.

name: death_latest_day
description: Latest day the death can fall on, the end of a month or year date.
details: Earliest end over every dated death source. Equals death_day when an exact day wins. Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status.

name: death_day_imputed_bool
description: TRUE when death_day is the middle of a month or year LLM date.
details: No exact-day source gave that day. Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status.

name: last_known_alive_day_imputed_bool
description: TRUE when last_known_alive_day is the middle of a month or year LLM date.
details: Table: pcx__outcome_vital_status.

name: fhir_deceased_bool
description: Patient.deceasedBoolean from the raw FHIR patient table, TRUE when deceasedDateTime is present (even when that date is cleared as implausible).
details: NULL when the site ETL populates neither.

name: fhir_death_day
description: Patient.deceasedDateTime at day precision, NULL outside 1980-01-01 to the build day.
details: NULL when the site ETL does not populate it or the date is implausible (pcx__warn_outcome_vital_status_conflict fhir_death_day_implausible).

name: last_encounter_day
description: Latest enc_period_end_day_filled in the study population, from 1980-01-01 to the build day.
details: Administrative evidence only; a later note may extend last_known_alive_day.

name: llm_deceased_bool
description: TRUE when any patient-task note gives vital_status DECEASED.

name: llm_death_day
details: Hard cast to DATE, precision not carried.

name: llm_event_deceased_bool
description: TRUE when any event-task note gives event_type DECEASED, dated or not.
details: Source: pcx__llm_event_wide. NULL when no event-task note documents death.

name: llm_event_death_day
details: Source: pcx__llm_event_wide. NULL when the death is undated or not documented by the event task.

name: llm_last_known_alive_day
details: Hard cast to DATE, precision not carried.

name: first_event_day
description: Day of the first EFS-type event, for durations.
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. A month or year date is used at the middle of its period (the 15th of the month, July 1 of the year), with first_event_day_imputed_bool TRUE. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event. Undated events cannot be first events. Kept as evidence even when event_timing_uncertain_bool is TRUE.

name: first_event_earliest_day
description: Earliest day the first event can be: the earliest start of any dated event.
details: A month or year date starts on its first day. Used to place exposures against the initial-therapy window. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: first_event_latest_day
description: Latest day the first event can be: the earliest end of any dated event.
details: A month or year date ends on its last day. Exposures starting on or after it are certainly not initial. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: first_event_day_imputed_bool
description: TRUE when first_event_day is the middle of a month or year date.
details: Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: first_event_type
description: Event type(s) on first_event_day, comma-joined when several share the date.
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: dated_event_bool
description: TRUE when a dated EFS-type event exists (first_event_day is not NULL).
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: event_timing_uncertain_bool
description: TRUE when an undated PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE or SECOND_MALIGNANCY mention may precede the dated first event.
details: An undated mention happened on or before its note date (pcx__llm_note_date). It is a restatement, ignored, when its note is dated on or after first_event_latest_day. Otherwise (earlier or undated note, or no dated event) it may precede first_event_day, so the EFS interval is NULL until it is reconciled (efs_censor_source event_timing_uncertain) and the initial-therapy flags are NULL. Tables: pcx__outcome_first_event, pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: death_undated_bool
description: TRUE when the patient is deceased but no source has a death date.
details: From deceased_bool or an undated DECEASED event mention. The patient was alive for every dated event and exposure, so an undated death never moves the first event earlier. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: event_documented_bool
description: TRUE when an EFS-type event is documented, dated or not.
details: dated_event_bool, event_timing_uncertain_bool or death_undated_bool. This is efs_event_bool. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: progression_first_day
description: Earliest dated PROGRESSION event, for durations.
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event. A month or year date is used at the middle of its period.

name: recurrence_first_day
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: second_malignancy_first_day
details: First event per README section 2: earliest of PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE, SECOND_MALIGNANCY and death. REMISSION, INITIAL_DIAGNOSIS and SECOND_PRIMARY are not counted. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: undated_event_cnt
description: Number of undated PROGRESSION, RECURRENCE and SECOND_MALIGNANCY mentions that are not restatements, NULL when there are none.
details: Sets event_timing_uncertain_bool. Undated DECEASED mentions are in death_undated_bool instead. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: undated_event_restated_cnt
description: Number of undated event mentions in notes dated on or after first_event_latest_day, NULL when none.
details: Restatements of the dated event, ignored for timing. Table: pcx__outcome_first_event.

name: days_t0_to_first_event
details: Negative values mean the event precedes time zero and need review.

name: had_initial_methotrexate_bool
description: Methotrexate received as initial therapy (README section 2).
details: Initial therapy runs from t0_day to the first event. Each pcx__exposure_record row is inside the window (starts on or after t0_day and ends before the first event can have happened), outside it, possibly inside it (a range that crosses either end, or an undated mention whose note is dated on or after t0_day), or a restatement (ignored). TRUE: a record inside. FALSE: none inside or possibly inside, and initial therapy is documented without it (a chemotherapy record inside the window, or methotrexate EXPLICITLY_NOT_RECEIVED). NULL: unknown, meaning no t0, event_timing_uncertain_bool, a record possibly inside, or no initial therapy documented. Missing documentation is never FALSE. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: had_initial_chemo_bool
details: Initial therapy runs from t0_day to the first event. Each pcx__exposure_record row is inside the window (starts on or after t0_day and ends before the first event can have happened), outside it, possibly inside it (a range that crosses either end, or an undated mention whose note is dated on or after t0_day), or a restatement (ignored). TRUE: a record inside. FALSE: none inside or possibly inside, and initial therapy is documented without it (a radiation record inside the window). NULL: unknown, meaning no t0, event_timing_uncertain_bool, a record possibly inside, or no initial therapy documented. Missing documentation is never FALSE. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: had_initial_radiation_bool
description: Radiation received as initial therapy (README section 2).
details: Initial therapy runs from t0_day to the first event. Each pcx__exposure_record row is inside the window (starts on or after t0_day and ends before the first event can have happened), outside it, possibly inside it (a range that crosses either end, or an undated mention whose note is dated on or after t0_day), or a restatement (ignored). TRUE: a record inside. FALSE: none inside or possibly inside, and initial therapy is documented without it (a chemotherapy record inside the window, or radiation EXPLICITLY_NOT_RECEIVED). NULL: unknown, meaning no t0, event_timing_uncertain_bool, a record possibly inside, or no initial therapy documented. Missing documentation is never FALSE. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: methotrexate_initial_unknown_reason
description: Why had_initial_methotrexate_bool is NULL, NULL when it is known.
details: no_t0, event_timing_uncertain, possible_record (a record may fall inside the window), or no_initial_therapy_documented (no record possibly inside, and nothing documents initial therapy without it). pcx__warn_exposure_timing_unknown lists subjects with evidence whose flag is unknown. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: chemo_initial_unknown_reason
description: Why had_initial_chemo_bool is NULL, NULL when it is known.
details: no_t0, event_timing_uncertain, possible_record (a record may fall inside the window), or no_initial_therapy_documented (no record possibly inside, and nothing documents initial therapy without it). pcx__warn_exposure_timing_unknown lists subjects with evidence whose flag is unknown. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: radiation_initial_unknown_reason
description: Why had_initial_radiation_bool is NULL, NULL when it is known.
details: no_t0, event_timing_uncertain, possible_record (a record may fall inside the window), or no_initial_therapy_documented (no record possibly inside, and nothing documents initial therapy without it). pcx__warn_exposure_timing_unknown lists subjects with evidence whose flag is unknown. Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: initial_therapy_sequence
description: Order of chemotherapy and radiation within initial therapy (t0 to first event).
details: CHEMOTHERAPY_BEFORE_RADIATION or RADIATION_BEFORE_CHEMOTHERAPY when both had_initial flags are TRUE and one certainly starts first (by the ranges of their first days in the window), SAME_DAY when both start on the same exact day, CHEMOTHERAPY_ONLY or RADIATION_ONLY when one is TRUE and the other FALSE, NO_INITIAL_THERAPY when t0 and event timing are known and every chemotherapy and radiation record is outside the window, NULL when unknown (including overlapping month or year dates). Table: pcx__outcome_exposure.

name: protocol_names
description: Distinct treatment protocol names documented for the subject, pipe-joined.
details: From LLM regimen protocol_name_verbatim and timeline-anchor protocol_name. A protocol name does not establish enrollment, randomization or receipt.

name: os_event_bool
details: Overall survival per README section 3: origin t0_day, event death. Table: pcx__outcome.

name: os_end_day
description: death_day for deceased patients, otherwise last_known_alive_day.
details: Overall survival per README section 3: origin t0_day, event death. Table: pcx__outcome.

name: os_end_day_imputed_bool
description: TRUE when os_end_day is the middle of a month or year LLM date.
details: death_day_imputed_bool or last_known_alive_day_imputed_bool. Table: pcx__outcome.

name: os_days
details: Overall survival per README section 3: origin t0_day, event death. Table: pcx__outcome. NULL when either date is missing, including deceased patients without a death date.

name: efs_event_bool
description: TRUE when an EFS-type event is documented, dated or not (event_documented_bool).
details: Provisional event-free survival per README section 5. Table: pcx__outcome.

name: efs_end_day
description: first_event_day for a dated event, NULL when the event has no usable date or its timing is uncertain, otherwise last_known_alive_day.
details: Provisional event-free survival per README section 5. Table: pcx__outcome. Censoring on last-known-alive is a stand-in until dated event-free follow-up is adjudicated.

name: efs_end_day_imputed_bool
description: TRUE when efs_end_day is the middle of a month or year date.
details: first_event_day_imputed_bool or last_known_alive_day_imputed_bool, NULL when efs_end_day is NULL. Table: pcx__outcome.

name: efs_days
details: Provisional event-free survival per README section 5. Table: pcx__outcome. NULL when efs_end_day is NULL, including a documented event without a usable date.

name: efs_censor_source
details: Provisional event-free survival per README section 5. Table: pcx__outcome. event_timing_uncertain: an undated progression, recurrence or second malignancy, event_undated: only a death without a date, both with a NULL interval. Every censored row says provisional on purpose.

name: diagnosis
description: Latest documented CNS embryonal tumor subtype.
details: disease_subtype_ever from pcx__client_diagnosis (MEDULLOBLASTOMA, ATRT, ETMR, PINEOBLASTOMA, LEGACY_SPNET or OTHER_CNS_EMBRYONAL), Not Reported when none is documented. Not an exclusion: no diagnosis, age or prior-treatment filter is applied. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes, PCX-30 cube label.

name: overall_survival_years
description: Whole years from t0_day to os_end_day.
details: FLOOR(os_days / 365.25), 10 and over is >=10. Not Applicable when there is no t0_day, Not Reported when os_days is missing or negative. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject only. The cubes use the months column. PCX-30 label.

name: overall_survival_months
description: Whole months from t0_day to os_end_day.
details: FLOOR(os_days / 30.4375), the year divided by 12, no cap. Not Applicable when there is no t0_day, Not Reported when os_days is missing or negative. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes.

name: vital_status
details: deceased when os_event_bool is TRUE. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes, PCX-30 cube label.

name: event_free_survival_years
description: Whole years from t0_day to efs_end_day.
details: Provisional EFS per README section 5. FLOOR(efs_days / 365.25), 10 and over is >=10. Not Applicable when there is no t0_day, Not Reported when efs_days is missing or negative. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject only. The cubes use the months column. PCX-30 label.

name: event_free_survival_months
description: Whole months from t0_day to efs_end_day.
details: Provisional EFS per README section 5. FLOOR(efs_days / 30.4375), the year divided by 12, no cap. Not Applicable when there is no t0_day, Not Reported when efs_days is missing or negative, including an event without a usable date. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes.

name: efs_status
details: Provisional EFS per README section 5. event when efs_event_bool is TRUE, including an event without a usable date, whose event_free_survival_years and event_free_survival_months are Not Reported. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes, PCX-30 cube label.

name: age_at_diagnosis_under_36mo
details: From age_under_36_months_at_definitive_surgery. PCX-30 uses age at diagnosis, which equals the first tumor surgery for almost every PCX-30 patient. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes, PCX-30 cube label.

name: had_initial_methotrexate
description: Yes, No, Not Reported or Not Applicable.
details: Yes, No, Not Reported or Not Applicable. From had_initial_methotrexate_bool: TRUE is Yes, FALSE is No, NULL is Not Reported, Not Applicable when there is no t0_day. Initial therapy only (t0 to first event), so salvage after relapse is not counted. Replaces the PCX-30 ever column (ever_methotrexate). Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes.

name: had_initial_radiation
description: Yes, No, Not Reported or Not Applicable.
details: Yes, No, Not Reported or Not Applicable. From had_initial_radiation_bool: TRUE is Yes, FALSE is No, NULL is Not Reported, Not Applicable when there is no t0_day. Initial therapy only (t0 to first event), so salvage after relapse is not counted. Replaces the PCX-30 ever column (radiation). Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes.

name: initial_treatment_order
details: chemo_before_radiation, radiation_before_chemotherapy, radiation_and_chemo_same_day, chemo_only_no_initial_radiation, radiation_only_no_initial_chemo, no_initial_radiation_or_chemo (NO_INITIAL_THERAPY), Not Reported when initial_therapy_sequence is NULL, Not Applicable when there is no t0_day. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes, PCX-30 cube label.

name: protocol_name
description: Coded treatment protocol of any documented systemic therapy regimen.
details: From pcx__llm_systemic_therapy_regimen.protocol_name, any regimen ever documented, dated or not, not only initial therapy. The TreatmentProtocol code (such as ACNS0334, CCG99703, HEAD_START) when one protocol is named, Multiple when more than one is named, Not Reported when none is (NONE_OF_THE_ABOVE is not a protocol). A protocol name does not establish enrollment, randomization or receipt. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes.

name: documented_trial_arm
details: From pcx__llm_systemic_therapy_regimen.documented_trial_arm of ACNS0334 regimens only, so REGIMEN_B is always the high-dose methotrexate arm. REGIMEN_A, REGIMEN_B, Multiple when notes document both, Not Reported when an ACNS0334 regimen documents no arm, Not Applicable when no ACNS0334 regimen is documented. Arms of other protocols are ignored. Table: pcx__kaplan_subject and the pcx__cube_kaplan_* cubes.
